name: Warning Before Destruction
overview: Scripture reveals that God appoints watchmen to warn His people of impending judgment, emphasizing the serious responsibility of delivering His warnings faithfully as seen in Ezekiel 3 and 33. Pride and deception through indulgence, such as drunkenness, are identified as paths leading to destruction, underscoring the need for vigilance and humility (Proverbs 16:18; 20:1). Moreover, God’s prophetic servants are entrusted with revealing His purposes before judgment unfolds, demonstrating His justice and mercy in warning sinners to turn from iniquity (Amos 3:7; Ezekiel 3:20).
